1.w: And YHWH said to Moses, “Speak to the priests, the sons of Aaron, and say to them: No one shall defile himself for the dead among his people,

2.w: except for his close relative [who are] near to him—his mother, and his father, and his son, and his daughter, and his brother,

3.w: and his sister, the virgin, who is near to him, who has not had a husband. He may defile himself for her.

4.w: As a chief man he shall not defile himself among his people, to profane himself.

5.w: They shall not make baldness on their heads, and they shall not shave the edges of their beards, and they shall not make a cutting in their flesh.

6.w: They shall be Holy to their God and not profane the name of their God. For they offer the fire offerings of YHWH, the bread of their God; and they shall be holy.

7.w: And they shall not take a woman, a prostitute or defiled, or a woman cast out from her husband they shall not take, for he [is] holy to his God.

8.w: And you shall consecrate him, for he offers the bread of your God. He is Holy to you, for holy [am] I, YHWH, sanctifying you⁺.

9.w: And the daughter of any priest, if she profanes herself by playing the prostitute, she profanes her father; she shall be burned with the fire.

10.w: And the high priest among his brothers, on whose head is poured the anointing oil and [who] has consecrated his hand to put on the garments, shall not uncover his head and not tear his clothes.

11.w: And he shall not go near any dead body; he shall not defile himself for his father or his mother.

12.w: And he shall not go out of the sanctuary nor profane the sanctuary of his God; for the consecration of the anointing oil of his God [is] on him. I [am] YHWH.

13.w: And he shall take a wife in her virginity.

14.w: A widow or a divorced woman or a defiled woman—a prostitute—these he shall not marry; for rather he shall take a virgin of his own people as wife.

15.w: He shall not profane his posterity among his people. For I [am] YHWH, sanctifying him.”

16.w: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

17.w: “Speak to Aaron, saying, ‘No man of your seed to their generations who has a blemish in him shall draw near to bring near the bread of his God.

18.w: For any man who has a blemish in him shall not approach—a man blind, or lame, or disfigured, or deformed,

19.w: or a man who has in him a breach in the foot, or a breach in the hand,

20.w: or a hunchback, or dwarfed, or a man who has a blemish in his eye, or itch, or scab, or a crushed testicle.

21.w: Any man of the seed of Aaron the priest who has a blemish in him shall not come near to offer the fire offerings to YHWH; he has a blemish in him. He shall not come near to offer the bread of his God.

22.w: He may eat the bread of his God from the holies of holies, and from the holies.

23.w: Only he shall not go near the veil. And he shall not approach the altar, because he has a blemish in him. And he shall not profane My sanctuaries, for I [am] YHWH, sanctifying them.’”

24.w: And Moses told [it] to Aaron, and to his sons, and to all the sons of Israel.
